'''Mar Balayan''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who worked for the [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Republic Scout Service]] and later became a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]].<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Biography==
Balayan was a member of the Republic Scout Services. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]], Balayan turned to selling sapients into slavery. He preyed on species he had discovered but not reported to authorities. He operated in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]], avoiding the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as he continued to sell beings into slavery.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />
